name: svg-french-press-qwen3.8-27b-v2-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="780" height="1010" viewBox="0 0 780 1010" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="7" height="7" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="7" height="7" fill="#efe9df"/>
      <path d="M0 0H7M0 0V7" stroke="#a39c8e" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="grid" width="18" height="18" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="18" height="18" fill="#d7dbe0"/>
      <path d="M0 0H18M0 0V18" stroke="#707a86" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    </pattern>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#dcecf4"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#f4fbfe"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#cfe4ef"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8d959f"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#d9dee4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7f8791"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="4.5" refY="4.5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0 0 L9 4.5 L0 9 Z" fill="#5a6068"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect width="780" height="1010" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="350" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#22262b">French press — exploded assembly</text>
  <text x="350" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#5a6068">Standard three-piece plunger filter (lid, cross retainer, mesh screen)</text>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="350" y1="96" x2="350" y2="952" stroke="#9aa1a9" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>

  <!-- ===== LID (top) ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- knob -->
    <path d="M332 132 Q350 104 368 132 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="132" rx="20" ry="5" fill="#9aa2ab" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- lid body -->
    <path d="M236 140 L230 166 A120 16 0 0 0 470 166 L464 140 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="140" rx="114" ry="15" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="140" rx="78" ry="9.5" fill="#aeb6bf" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- down arrow below lid -->
  <line x1="350" y1="186" x2="350" y2="212" stroke="#5a6068" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- ===== PLUNGER ROD ===== -->
  <g>
    <rect x="344" y="226" width="12" height="158" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="337" y="380" width="26" height="10" rx="2" fill="#8d959f" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="234" x2="347" y2="376" stroke="#eef1f4" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="350" y1="398" x2="350" y2="420" stroke="#5a6068" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- ===== CROSS RETAINER (filter frame) ===== -->
  <g>
    <path d="M262 432 L258 458 A92 12 0 0 0 442 458 L438 432 Z" fill="url(#grid)" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="432" rx="88" ry="11" fill="#e4e7eb" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <!-- cross seen from above -->
    <path d="M350 421 L350 443 M300 432 L400 432" stroke="#5f666e" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="432" r="4" fill="#5f666e"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="350" y1="472" x2="350" y2="492" stroke="#5a6068" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- ===== MESH SCREEN (filter disc) ===== -->
  <g>
    <path d="M255 500 L252 514 A98 12 0 0 0 448 514 L445 500 Z" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#7c7466" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="95" ry="11.5" fill="#f3eee4" stroke="#7c7466" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="9" ry="2.4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c7466" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="350" y1="530" x2="350" y2="552" stroke="#5a6068" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- ===== GLASS CARAFE ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M245 566 L455 566 L449 792 L251 792 Z" fill="url(#glass)" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="#5a7284" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- inner wall -->
    <path d="M256 566 L262 786 M444 566 L438 786" fill="none" stroke="#9db4c2" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M246 560 L220 534 L251 549 Z" fill="url(#glass)" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="#5a7284" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- rim -->
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="566" rx="105" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#5a7284" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="566" rx="97" ry="10" fill="none" stroke="#9db4c2" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <!-- outer bottom -->
    <path d="M251 792 A99 12 0 0 0 449 792" fill="none" stroke="#5a7284" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- inner bottom -->
    <path d="M256 788 A94 9 0 0 0 444 788" fill="none" stroke="#9db4c2" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M455 606 C548 602 552 708 458 712" fill="none" stroke="#3d434b" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M455 611 C540 608 543 703 458 707" fill="none" stroke="#6b727b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- liquid hint -->
    <path d="M262 700 L438 700 L444 786 L256 786 Z" fill="#8a5a2e" fill-opacity="0.35"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="700" rx="88" ry="9" fill="#a06a35" fill-opacity="0.45"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== BASE ===== -->
  <g>
    <line x1="350" y1="800" x2="350" y2="824" stroke="#5a6068" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <path d="M254 830 L446 830 L452 862 L248 862 Z" fill="#454b53" stroke="#2b3036" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="830" rx="96" ry="11" fill="#5c636c" stroke="#2b3036" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="862" rx="102" ry="11" fill="#33383f" stroke="#2b3036" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== LABELS ===== -->
  <g font-size="16" fill="#22262b">
    <g stroke="#8a9099" stroke-width="1.2">
      <line x1="472" y1="150" x2="540" y2="150"/>
      <line x1="362" y1="300" x2="540" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="444" y1="444" x2="540" y2="444"/>
      <line x1="450" y1="506" x2="540" y2="506"/>
      <line x1="245" y1="730" x2="180" y2="730"/>
      <line x1="462" y1="846" x2="540" y2="846"/>
    </g>
    <text x="548" y="155">Lid (finial on plunger)</text>
    <text x="548" y="305">Plunger rod</text>
    <text x="548" y="449">Cross retainer (frame)</text>
    <text x="548" y="511">Mesh filter screen</text>
    <text x="548" y="851">Base</text>
  </g>
  <text x="172" y="735" text-anchor="end" font-size="16" fill="#22262b">Glass carafe</text>

  <!-- note: three-piece group -->
  <g font-size="14" fill="#4a6a4a">
    <path d="M212 120 L212 522" stroke="#4a6a4a" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M198 120 H212 M198 522 H212" stroke="#4a6a4a" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <text x="188" y="310" transform="rotate(-90 188 310)" text-anchor="middle">plunger filter — 3 pieces</text>
  </g>
</svg>
